title: Mexican Fish Tacos
description: A twist on traditional British fish and chips, this Mexican-inspired dish features cod in a crispy taco shell.
instructions: Heat 1/4 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Dredge cod fillets in flour and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain cod on paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Warm corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing a piece of cod on a tortilla, then topping with a spoonful of Mexican crema, diced onion, sliced radishes, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Serve immediately, with tortilla chips on the side.
